text:
sam: quick q — for the softfail/handshake flow in rollouts, do we want operators to explicitly ACK fallback handoffs or should viewing the inbox item be considered implicit?
anna: my vote: explicit ACK. we need an auditable decision event (who/when/why). implicit view -> easy to miss. :eyes:
sam: yeah +1. explicit prevents accidental drift. UX Q: should ACK have a short TTL (auto-apply) or be manual-only?
kai: prefer short TTL (like 5m) with a clear banner: 'auto-apply in 5m unless rejected'. ops can cancel. helps when operator is OOTO.
lucy: +1 to TTL, but make it configurable per-rollout. some customers want manual-only for sensitive apps.
sam: ok configurable. also thinking about idempotency: store a decision event id and surface it in the operator inbox and in the rollout timeline. that way replays and audits are unambiguous.
anna: agree. event model sketch: decision_id, actor, action (accept/reject/simulate), reason, ttl_seconds, applied_at (nullable), originating_node. simple JSON to store.
sam: rough proto we can use in API and telemetry:```json
{"decision_id":"uuid","actor":"string","action":"accept|reject|simulate","reason":"string","ttl":300}"```. can we persist this to the rollout history and to event logs?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: recorded rollout.handshake.request (id=uuid-1234) at 1751112223 - status: pending
lucy: one more: allow 'simulate' that runs in a sandbox for 1 request and records a sample response for ops to inspect before ACK. helps debug false positives.
kai: implementation note: simulate should be rate-limited and not consume customer quotas. mark simulated requests in telemetry with trace_id and "simulated":true.
anna: UI asks: show compact diff of before/after model variant + estimated latency/cost delta at top of inbox item. operator can toggle details.
sam: agreed. also add a small inline edit to change TTL when ACKing (dropdown: 5m/15m/1h/manual). default from rollout policy.
lucy: for audit, we must surface the full decision JSON in timeline and have an 'export as CSV/JSON' option. compliance teams will love that.
anna: privacy check: redact customer prompt content from the audit export unless customer has agreed. include only metadata and sampled output when permitted.
sam: API stub for operator actions:```http
POST /api/rollouts/{id}/handshake
Body: {"decision_id":"uuid","action":"accept|reject|simulate","reason":"string","ttl":300}
Response: 200 {"status":"queued","applied_at":null,"decision_id":"uuid"}```
kai: backend: handshake handler should verify current rollout state, atomically record decision event, and if action==accept && ttl>0 schedule a background job to apply after ttl unless revoked.
anna: design note for console: show countdown timer for TTL and a 'revoke' button. if revoked, mark decision as revoked in event log and cancel job.
sam: ops-bot: can we get an automatic notification to #eng-oncall when manual rejection happens? and include a link to the simulated sample?
ops-bot: Notification rule added: on action==reject -> post to #eng-oncall with decision_id and link.
lucy: edge case: concurrent handshakes for the same rollout (two operators click accept almost simultaneously). need optimistic concurrency via decision_id and last_seen_revision. if collision, show conflict resolution dialog.
kai: yep use CAS on rollout revision. return 409 with current decision_id list and allow operator to merge/override (with extra confirmation).
anna: next steps: - PM to write acceptance criteria for ACK vs implicit - Design to mock inbox item with TTL dropdown + simulate panel - Backend to implement handshake API + event persistence - Ops-bot webhook for notifications
sam: I'll draft an ADR for the event schema and the API. tagging @ops-team for any objections.
lucy: thanks — will start a Figma for inbox states (pending, applied, revoked, conflicted).
anna: tiny UX ask: show operator initials + role in audit view (so audits show "Jane D. (oncall)").
sam: sounds good. if no objections I'll start work on the API and schedule a 30m sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: reminder: meeting scheduled by sam at 1751190000 for 30 minutes titled "softfail handshake sync"
__notes: This thread represents a single Slack thread; messages are concatenated in chronological order and prefixed by sender names. No title field included per agents.md rules.
